description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Raydar is recruiting for a fast-growing software company seeking a hands-on generalist Software Engineer. The role involves designing and delivering developer-facing packages, services, infrastructure, and tooling across the full stack, primarily in TypeScript, while contributing to product direction, code reviews, and AI-driven platform workflows.
TypeScript developer-tooling engineer building reliable packages, services, and AI-enabled workflows

Responsibilities:
• Design, build and release new capabilities for developer-facing packages and services, mainly in TypeScript
• Emphasize reliable infrastructure and tooling that other engineers can adopt with little effort
• Take part in a short daily sync to prioritize defects and incoming customer asks, then move into heads-down work on your own area
• Partner with senior leadership to weigh customer suggestions and help set product direction
• Write and review code changes with teammates, keeping quality standards high
• Contribute to AI-driven workflows that support the platform

Requirements:
• 1 to 5 years of professional software engineering experience
• A track record of creating tooling for other developers, such as shared packages, interfaces or public code projects
• Outstanding TypeScript skills, demonstrated through professional work or personal projects
• Comfort working on both client-side and server-side code
• Ongoing hands-on coding outside of work, for example a personal project
• A degree in computer science or a related technical field such as electrical engineering or mathematics with programming
• If coming from a large technology company, evidence of initiative and resourcefulness
• Ability to work independently and stay effective amid ambiguity in a fast-moving setting
• Ability to work on-site five days a week

Preferred:
• startup experience is valued
• Fluency in a second language or a demonstrated interest in languages
